Title: Define the event-feed query and card contract
Acceptance Criteria: Document the event-card fields and ordering rules; return only publishable upcoming events; support stable cursor pagination; define empty loading error and end-of-feed states

Title: Build the full-screen vertical event feed
Acceptance Criteria: Render one swipeable or scroll-snapped event card per viewport; show flyer or video title organization date time location and category; preserve the current position when returning from details

Title: Add feed pagination media lifecycle and recovery states
Acceptance Criteria: Load the next page before the user reaches the end; autoplay only the active video and pause off-screen media; show retry on failure; avoid duplicate cards during pagination

Title: Verify vertical-feed behavior and accessibility
Acceptance Criteria: Automated tests cover ordering pagination loading empty error and restoration; keyboard and screen-reader navigation work; scrolling remains responsive with at least 50 events

Title: Define the canonical event category taxonomy
Acceptance Criteria: Store a controlled category value for every event; include at least social academic career sports and an explicit other value; document labels icons and migration behavior

Title: Build accessible category filter controls
Acceptance Criteria: Users can select clear and change categories from Feed and Explore; the active state is visually and programmatically identifiable; controls work by touch and keyboard

Title: Connect category filters to event queries
Acceptance Criteria: Filtering returns only matching published upcoming events; filter state survives pagination and back navigation; clearing restores the unfiltered feed without a full reload

Title: Test category filtering and edge cases
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover each category no matches rapid filter changes pagination and events with legacy or unknown categories; empty results offer a clear reset action

Title: Create the canonical event-detail route and data load
Acceptance Criteria: A stable event ID deep link opens the correct event; direct navigation and refresh work; deleted unpublished unauthorized and unknown events show explicit states

Title: Render complete event information and media
Acceptance Criteria: Display title organizer verification status description flyer or video category start and end time timezone location directions capacity and current attendance using accessible formatting

Title: Connect detail-page actions to their feature flows
Acceptance Criteria: Save share NFC check-in and QR fallback actions appear only when applicable; expired full cancelled and unauthorized events disable actions with a reason

Title: Test event details across roles and event states
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover student organization leader admin signed-out missing cancelled full past and upcoming states; all interactive controls have labels and deterministic focus order

Title: Add the per-user saved-event data model and API
Acceptance Criteria: A user can create list and delete a bookmark identified by user and event; the pair is unique; operations are authorized and idempotent; saves persist across devices and sessions

Title: Implement save and unsave interactions
Acceptance Criteria: Feed and detail controls show the server-backed saved state; optimistic updates roll back on failure; repeated taps cannot create duplicate bookmarks; success is announced accessibly

Title: Build the Saved Events view and reminder handoff
Acceptance Criteria: Saved Events lists the signed-in user's upcoming saves in chronological order; removed or cancelled events are handled; save and unsave changes update the list and reminder schedule

Title: Test bookmark persistence authorization and synchronization
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover reload cross-device synchronization duplicate requests unsave cancellation signed-out access and API failure; one user's bookmarks are never visible to another

Title: Define canonical shareable event links
Acceptance Criteria: Each published event has one canonical URL containing a stable opaque event ID; the link opens the same event after login or install handoff; unpublished events are not exposed

Title: Implement native share with copy-link fallback
Acceptance Criteria: Share uses the platform share sheet when supported and copies the canonical link otherwise; the shared title and summary identify the event; cancel is not reported as an error

Title: Handle authentication and unavailable-event link states
Acceptance Criteria: Signed-out recipients return to the event after authentication; cancelled deleted expired or unauthorized links show a safe explanatory state and never leak private event data

Title: Test deep links and share fallbacks
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover direct navigation refresh login return native sharing clipboard fallback invalid IDs and unavailable events on supported mobile and web targets

Title: Define the secure NFC check-in protocol
Acceptance Criteria: Document payload claims issuer audience expiry nonce event and reader binding; tokens are server-issued signed short-lived and single-use; no credential or reusable secret is stored in the NFC payload

Title: Implement server validation and attendance recording
Acceptance Criteria: The server verifies signature expiry event window role and nonce then atomically writes one attendance record; invalid attempts write no attendance and return a non-sensitive reason code

Title: Build student and organization NFC flows
Acceptance Criteria: A student can present or transmit the check-in credential and an authorized organization device can validate it; both devices show pending success and failure states; QR fallback is offered when NFC is unavailable

Title: Run cross-device NFC integration and security tests
Acceptance Criteria: Tests use separate student and organization sessions; successful tap writes attendance and updates the dashboard; tampered expired replayed wrong-event and unauthorized credentials are rejected

Title: Define dual-authentication enrollment and recovery
Acceptance Criteria: Document the primary credential second factor enrollment verification recovery and reset flows; define rate limits session lifetime trusted-device policy and auditable security events

Title: Implement secure primary authentication
Acceptance Criteria: Passwords are hashed server-side; generic errors prevent account enumeration; login attempts are rate-limited; authenticated sessions use secure expiry and revocation; no credential is stored in client storage

Title: Implement and enforce the second authentication factor
Acceptance Criteria: Enrollment verifies possession before activation; protected login is incomplete until the second factor succeeds; expired reused and incorrect codes fail; recovery invalidates prior sessions when required

Title: Test authentication abuse and recovery scenarios
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover valid login invalid password invalid or expired second factor throttling logout revocation recovery and protected-route access; editing client state cannot bypass either factor

Title: Enforce one attendance record per student and event
Acceptance Criteria: Add a database uniqueness rule for student plus event; the check-in transaction is atomic; repeated NFC QR and retry requests return the original success or a duplicate result without adding points

Title: Add replay and concurrent-request protection
Acceptance Criteria: Consume each nonce once; concurrent validations cannot create multiple records; cross-channel attempts for the same event are deduplicated; suspicious replay attempts are audit logged

Title: Show a clear duplicate-check-in result
Acceptance Criteria: Student and organization views distinguish already checked in from technical failure; show the original check-in time when authorized; no retry control implies another attendance record will be created

Title: Test duplicate prevention under retries and races
Acceptance Criteria: Automated tests cover double taps rescans refreshes NFC then QR QR then NFC concurrent requests and network retries; every case leaves exactly one attendance row and one reward grant

Title: Create short-lived signed QR credentials
Acceptance Criteria: Server issues signed event- and student-bound QR credentials with a 20-second lifetime and unique nonce; expired tampered wrong-event and reused codes are rejected

Title: Build the student rotating-QR screen
Acceptance Criteria: The event detail opens a scannable QR with visible countdown; a new credential replaces it every 20 seconds; screenshots or stale views clearly expire; offline and fetch failures show recovery guidance

Title: Build the organization QR scanner and validation flow
Acceptance Criteria: Only authorized organization users can scan; camera permission denial has guidance; validation records attendance through the same server path as NFC and immediately reports success duplicate or invalid

Title: Test QR rotation scanning and replay resistance
Acceptance Criteria: Tests verify 20-second rotation clock skew camera denial cross-device success expired codes screenshots replay duplicate prevention and dashboard updates

Title: Add notification permission and reminder preferences
Acceptance Criteria: Users can grant or deny permission and enable or disable saved-event reminders; preference is stored per user and synchronized across sessions; denial does not block saving events

Title: Schedule reminders 30 minutes before saved events
Acceptance Criteria: Saving an eligible future event schedules one reminder for 30 minutes before its start in the event timezone; past or too-soon events follow a documented rule; duplicate jobs are not created

Title: Keep reminders synchronized with event and bookmark changes
Acceptance Criteria: Unsave cancellation deletion start-time change timezone change and preference opt-out cancel or reschedule the job; notification links open the correct event detail

Title: Test push delivery timing and lifecycle
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover permission states 30-minute timing timezones daylight-saving changes duplicate saves rescheduling cancellation opt-out provider failure and event deep links

Title: Define the event input schema and validation rules
Acceptance Criteria: Specify required title organization description category start and end timestamps timezone location capacity visibility and media fields; reject invalid ranges past dates and unauthorized organizations

Title: Build the accessible event creation form
Acceptance Criteria: Organization leaders can enter every required field; labels instructions and field errors are accessible; date and time inputs preserve timezone; entered data survives validation errors

Title: Connect form submission to draft event creation
Acceptance Criteria: Submitting valid data creates a server-side draft owned by the user's verified organization; double submission is prevented; API failures retain input and provide a retry path

Title: Test event creation validation roles and failure states
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover required fields invalid dates capacity boundaries timezone roles duplicate submit server errors keyboard completion and successful draft creation

Title: Define secure media storage and upload policy
Acceptance Criteria: Document allowed image and video formats byte and duration limits retention ownership and delivery URLs; use server-authorized upload credentials; reject mismatched MIME types and unsafe files

Title: Build upload progress preview replacement and removal
Acceptance Criteria: The form accepts supported flyers and videos; shows validation upload progress preview retry replace and remove actions; failed uploads do not lose other event fields

Title: Process and deliver event media reliably
Acceptance Criteria: Generate suitable image thumbnails or video poster metadata; serve media through durable URLs; clean abandoned uploads; preserve aspect ratio and avoid autoplaying off-screen video

Title: Test media validation upload recovery and accessibility
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover valid formats oversize unsupported or spoofed files cancellation retry replacement cleanup rendering and alt text or caption requirements

Title: Model the event publication state machine
Acceptance Criteria: Define draft published updated cancelled and archived states plus legal transitions; persist author organization and timestamps; only published events are publicly discoverable

Title: Implement draft save edit and resume
Acceptance Criteria: Organization leaders can save incomplete drafts list their drafts reopen them and continue editing; only members of the owning organization can view or change a draft

Title: Implement publish validation and post-publish changes
Acceptance Criteria: Publish requires all mandatory fields valid media and any required organization approval; successful publish records the actor and time; edits cancellation and unpublish follow explicit rules

Title: Test state transitions authorization and visibility
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover every allowed and rejected transition concurrent edits ownership verified status publish failures and proof that drafts never appear in public queries

Title: Define public event eligibility and distribution rules
Acceptance Criteria: Document how publish state organization verification start time cancellation visibility and moderation determine feed eligibility; rules are enforced in one server-side query boundary

Title: Distribute newly published events to discovery surfaces
Acceptance Criteria: A published eligible event appears in Feed Explore category results organization profile and direct links without manual reload; ordering and cache invalidation are consistent

Title: Propagate event edits cancellations and unpublishing
Acceptance Criteria: Title time category media and capacity edits refresh all surfaces; cancellation is clearly marked; unpublished or deleted events are removed from discovery and caches promptly

Title: Test distribution visibility ordering and cache behavior
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover verified and unverified organizations publish edits cancellation unpublish future and past events categories pagination and multi-session visibility

Title: Create attendance summary and live-update contracts
Acceptance Criteria: Expose authorized event totals unique attendees check-in timestamps and capacity percentage; define snapshot plus incremental update messages; never expose attendance for another organization

Title: Build the organization live attendance dashboard
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized leaders see event identity current unique check-ins capacity percentage recent activity and last-updated state; new validated check-ins appear without refresh

Title: Handle reconnect ordering and dashboard failure states
Acceptance Criteria: After disconnect the client indicates stale data reconnects and reconciles with a fresh snapshot; duplicate or out-of-order messages do not inflate counts; closed events remain readable

Title: Test live counts authorization and resilience
Acceptance Criteria: Cross-device tests prove NFC and QR check-ins update the correct dashboard once; tests cover reconnect races duplicates capacity calculation empty attendance and unauthorized access

Title: Define capacity thresholds and alert preferences
Acceptance Criteria: Define default warning and full thresholds with allowed organization overrides; store preferences per event or organization; reject invalid capacity and threshold combinations

Title: Implement idempotent capacity alert evaluation
Acceptance Criteria: Each attendance change evaluates occupancy; crossing configured thresholds emits one alert per threshold; retries and duplicate check-ins do not send duplicate alerts; capacity edits recalculate safely

Title: Show warning and full states in organization tools
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard visibly distinguishes normal warning and full states; authorized leaders receive configured alerts; the UI explains threshold values and never reports occupancy above the unique-attendee count

Title: Test threshold crossings edits and concurrency
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover below at and above thresholds concurrent check-ins duplicate attempts capacity changes preference opt-out provider retry and no duplicate alert delivery

Title: Define organization verification records and queue query
Acceptance Criteria: Persist applicant organization evidence submitted time current status reviewer and decision metadata; admins can page sort and filter pending records; non-admin access is rejected

Title: Build the admin verification queue
Acceptance Criteria: Admins see pending applications with organization identity age completeness and status; search filters pagination loading empty error and retry states are present

Title: Build the verification review detail view
Acceptance Criteria: An admin can inspect all submitted evidence and decision history before acting; sensitive fields are limited to authorized roles; stale or already-decided records are visibly read-only

Title: Test queue persistence privacy and concurrent review
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover filters pagination reload data isolation missing evidence stale records two-admin conflicts and denial of student or organization-leader access

Title: Define verification decision transitions and audit rules
Acceptance Criteria: Pending can transition once to approved or rejected under documented reopen rules; every decision records admin time reason and prior state; organization verified status changes atomically

Title: Implement secure approve and reject actions
Acceptance Criteria: Only admins can decide; rejection requires a reason and approval requires confirmation; stale revisions fail safely; repeated requests are idempotent and never create conflicting states

Title: Add decision confirmation status and notification handoff
Acceptance Criteria: The UI confirms the selected organization and outcome before submission; success updates the queue immediately; failure preserves context; approved and rejected applicants receive the correct notification event

Title: Test decisions authorization audit and races
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover approve reject reason validation duplicate requests concurrent admins authorization verified-state propagation audit history queue removal and notification event emission

Title: Define the role and permission matrix
Acceptance Criteria: Document student organization leader admin and service permissions for every page API and resource action; include ownership rules and deny-by-default behavior

Title: Enforce authorization on every server operation
Acceptance Criteria: Central middleware and resource checks enforce role plus ownership; client-supplied roles are ignored; unauthorized requests use consistent responses and access attempts are audit logged

Title: Apply role-aware navigation and protected routes
Acceptance Criteria: Users see only valid navigation and actions; direct navigation to protected pages is blocked; authentication expiry returns users safely to sign-in and preserves an allowed return destination

Title: Test the complete permission matrix and bypass attempts
Acceptance Criteria: Automated tests exercise every role-action pair ownership boundary direct URL API call modified client state expired session and cross-organization access; all denied operations leave data unchanged

Title: Define authorized report filters and export contract
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized admins or organization leaders can choose allowed organization event and date-range scopes; server applies ownership filters; report columns formats timezone and ordering are documented

Title: Generate safe and correct CSV output
Acceptance Criteria: Export is generated from persisted attendance; headers and row ordering are stable; commas quotes and newlines are escaped; spreadsheet-formula injection is neutralized; filename and content type are correct

Title: Build report filtering download and failure states
Acceptance Criteria: Users can select scope preview summary counts start download and retry; empty results produce a valid header-only export or explicit no-data state; repeated clicks do not start duplicate jobs

Title: Test report accuracy privacy and spreadsheet safety
Acceptance Criteria: Tests reconcile export rows to database records and dashboard totals; cover filters timezones large exports escaping formula payloads empty data and cross-organization denial

Title: Design the relational data model and timestamp policy
Acceptance Criteria: ERD covers users organizations memberships events bookmarks check-in nonces attendance verifications notification jobs and audit events; timestamps use UTC-capable types and display timezone rules are documented

Title: Create migrations constraints indexes and seed data
Acceptance Criteria: Repeatable migrations create foreign keys uniqueness checks and indexes for event feed attendance dashboard verification and reporting queries; seed data uses valid ISO timestamps and can be reset safely

Title: Implement repositories and authorized data APIs
Acceptance Criteria: Repository interfaces cover required event attendance bookmark verification and report operations; API transactions preserve integrity; pagination filtering errors and authorization follow documented contracts

Title: Verify integrity migrations performance and recovery
Acceptance Criteria: Tests cover clean migration upgrade rollback strategy constraints transaction failures and representative query performance; backup restore and retention procedures are documented and exercised in staging

Title: Define notification provider templates and delivery policy
Acceptance Criteria: Choose supported push and email providers; define reminder approval rejection and failure templates; document sender identity localization sensitive-data rules retention and environment configuration

Title: Implement queued idempotent notification delivery
Acceptance Criteria: Persist delivery jobs with recipient channel template payload schedule status and idempotency key; worker sends asynchronously with bounded retries backoff dead-letter handling and no duplicate delivery

Title: Apply preferences consent and delivery observability
Acceptance Criteria: Honor channel preferences and email opt-out while preserving mandatory security messages; record provider IDs attempts and final status without logging secrets; expose operational failure counts

Title: Integrate and test reminders and verification messages
Acceptance Criteria: End-to-end tests prove saved-event reminders and approval or rejection messages use correct recipients content links timing preferences and idempotency; provider failure retries and dead-letter alerts are verified
